recipes.name: The Station
setup: Linux worker with a dedicated writable cgroup v2 child under /sys/fs/cgroup, cpu/memory/pids controllers delegated and cgroup.kill available. No host cgroup configuration is changed automatically.

Prepared Station Python environment with its pinned requirements and task dependencies; named conda evaluation environment, explicit Codex executable and authenticated Codex state. No install, authentication or deployment runs during preparation.

OPENAI_API_KEY and any required Codex authentication are provided explicitly through inherited environment names or worker-owned CLI state; model and coder-model plus all resource/session bounds are required.

profiles.description: Foreground native Station research ecosystem and automatic evaluator for the pinned 32-circle packing task; native tick limit with evaluation draining.

evaluation.description: Station AutoResearchEvaluator runs the native Research Center coder/submission lifecycle and circle_n32 Task1Evaluator; validity and sum-of-radii scores remain native records, never canonical Arena receipts. Session completion requires the requested tick boundary and drained native evaluation queues.

argument_help: Required: --model MODEL --coder-model MODEL --agents N --ticks N --context-tokens N --response-tokens N --wall-seconds N --eval-seconds N --eval-workers N --cpus N --memory-gib N --max-processes N --conda-env NAME --cgroup-root /sys/fs/cgroup/DELEGATED_ROOT
Provide request.executables.codex as an absolute prepared executable; the shared driver fingerprints it and supplies --codex-binary.
Set outer timeout_seconds above wall-seconds plus cleanup allowance; pass OPENAI_API_KEY through environment_names. Native model/provider/runtime readiness remains unverified.
limitations: Source and inert fixture checks only; no paid/native research session has run.

Linux cgroup v2 lifecycle/resource containment is required because native Codex and evaluation children start separate sessions; this is not a security sandbox or a cloud/Docker dispatcher. Use a dedicated worker with no sensitive host data.
This profile uses the native circle_n32 task and OpenAI agent/reviewer/reflection connectors plus Codex coder/surveyor. It does not register canonical task-library support.
Model context/output limits and native ticks are not a monetary API budget. Native evaluations may remain incomplete when the wall limit cancels the entire cgroup.
The public dashboard/start.sh deployment and multistart branches are not launched; native single-station research/evaluation behavior is otherwise delegated to the pinned implementation.
